title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28.1): Create new Purchase Invoice from PDF (Out-of-the-Box)
summary: In BC28.1 (2026 wave 1) the Payables Agent can create purchase invoices from a PDF that users upload with New from PDF on the Purchase Invoices page, so the process no longer depends only on emailed invoices. The agent identifies the vendor and builds a draft with reasoning tips for review. The invoice is created after the user confirms. It stops if the vendor cannot be identified.
key_points: Purchase invoices can now be created manually from PDF files via a new 'New from PDF' button on the Purchase Invoices page, complementing the existing email-based Payables Agent workflow
The Payables Agent analyzes PDF documents, identifies the vendor, and generates a draft with suggested field values and explanations of its reasoning
Users review the draft, confirm details section by section, and can adjust values before finalizing the purchase invoice creation
This feature consumes Copilot credits (65 credits in the test example) and automatically enables the Payables Agent

quotes.text: We can now manually upload a PDF to create a Purchase Invoice.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core capability addition that eliminates dependency on email-triggered workflows for vendor invoice processing
